mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 2% signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing price index of more than 3% signals weakening consumer balance sheets and reduced discretionary spending, which depresses earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of housing price declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in industrial production of more than 2% signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of industrial production contraction (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, which depresses earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures of more than 2% signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining real personal consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 2% combined with a 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals strong labor market conditions and higher consumer spending, which boosts earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 2% AND UNRATE < 5% for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).
